summary: Canadian Imperial Bank of Commerce filed a 424B5 underlying supplement for senior unsecured notes linked to one or more exchange-traded funds. The filing is a routine shelf takedown under Rule 424(b)(5) to register structured notes; no acquisition, divestiture, or other special situation is involved. The notes are unsecured, not FDIC or CDIC insured, and subject to CIBC credit risk. Proceeds will be used for hedging. There are no deal terms, premiums, or board recommendations. This is a standard capital markets offering, not a special situation.
